safety_tip_en: Do not break CRT glass; hand it to an authorized recycler.
safety_tip_hi: CRT glass na todein; ise authorized recycler ko dein.
safety_tip_mr: CRT glass phodu naka; authorized recycler kade dya.

safety_tip_en: Keep panels intact and avoid direct skin contact with broken glass.
safety_tip_hi: Panel ko intact rakhein aur broken glass ko seedha na chhuyein.
safety_tip_mr: Panel intact theva ani tutlelya glass la directly sparsh karu naka.

safety_tip_en: Do not burn circuit boards; fumes are harmful.
safety_tip_hi: Circuit boards na jalayein; dhuan hanikarak hai.
safety_tip_mr: Circuit boards jalu naka; dhur hanikarak aahe.

safety_tip_en: Do not burn cables to remove metal; sell them intact.
safety_tip_hi: Metal nikalne ke liye cables na jalayein; intact bechein.
safety_tip_mr: Metal kadhnyasathi cables jalu naka; intact vika.

safety_tip_en: Do not open or crush batteries; store away from heat.
safety_tip_hi: Batteries ko na kholein na crush karein; garmi se door rakhein.
safety_tip_mr: Batteries ughadu naka kiwa crush karu naka; ushnetepasun door theva.

safety_tip_en: Keep motors dry and separate from batteries.
safety_tip_hi: Motors ko sookha rakhein aur batteries se alag rakhein.
safety_tip_mr: Motors korade theva ani batteries pasun vegale theva.

safety_tip_en: Keep plastics separate from hazardous parts.
safety_tip_hi: Plastic ko hazardous parts se alag rakhein.
safety_tip_mr: Plastic hazardous parts pasun vegale theva.
